title: Chapter 460
paragraphs: Chapter 460
Episode 131. People with good intuition, people with bad intuition (4)
They tied the boat to a reef and went up to the island.
"It seems that there were guards here just a moment ago. Hmm... Judging by the footprints, I smell the traces of the special forces."
Lata spoke while looking at the footprints nearby.
"Special forces? Can you tell just by looking at the footprints?"
"It's a kind of intuition and experience, my lord. Due to the nature of my job, I often had encounters with them. There's a subtle pattern that's difficult to explain."
"If my brother says so, it must be the special forces for sure."
"These guys aren't some kind of beasts, they can recognize all sorts of things. Isn't that right, kid?"

It was amazing to see the Proch siblings so confident just by looking at the footprints. It was an ability he didn't have. Of course, this was a story when it was revealed that special forces existed.
Upon closer examination, the battle didn't just take place in the center of the island. Smoke and flames were rising from various places on the large and small islands lined up side by side.
In other words, localized battles were breaking out in various places.
The distance between the islands was close enough to move by swimming or jumping. They decided to go around the islands and observe the situation.
Aaaah...! Ugh!
As they moved, they could hear screams coming from somewhere.
The beautiful islands with unspoiled nature, the warm wind, and the sunny weather didn't match the increasing number of elements that didn't belong.
The group couldn't help but feel a strange sense of dissonance.
"Hey, kid."
"Yeah?"
"Don't these screams sound strange?"
Jin nodded.
"It's like the screams of untrained ordinary people in fear."
"That's what I hear too, my lord."
It was too big a scream to be from island residents or other ordinary people. It carried the energy unique to a martial artist who had achieved at least level 6.
Of course, there is no rule that those who are well-trained and accustomed to war must scream beautifully.
However, those who came to Gaipa Island now were the troops of the four major powers. All of them were brought with the recognition that they could cause friction with each other.
At the very least, they should all be composed of elite personnel.
It was a surprising point that such people were soaked in fear and screaming so loudly.
The newly arrived island had a desolate hill-like terrain. Thanks to its relatively high altitude, when they reached the top, they could see the entire island in front of them.
And the group could face a shocking scene they had never imagined before.
"Eeheeek, Eeeek!"
"Ugh!"
They saw a group of people running around haphazardly, screaming like terrified animals.
"Huh, what's going on? What's happening over there?"
"Those are the Royal... Army, Lord Murakan."
The people running around were the Royal Elite Army.
Even the flags symbolizing the Vermont Royal Family were torn and scattered on the ground. The Royal Elite Army was stepping on them as they ran.
What on earth had happened to these elite troops? There was nothing visible at the moment.
However, in just a few seconds, they could tell what was driving the Royal Elite Army mad.
"My lord, this seems to be..."
"They're not fighting with someone else."
The Royal Elite Army they were watching was fighting amongst themselves. With such crude weapon skills and gestures, one couldn't believe they were elite soldiers.
As if they were under a spell or completely blind, they constantly screamed and swung their weapons.
Thunk! Swish! Ugh...! For a while, the group lay down on a rock and watched their behavior.
They contemplated what could be happening on the island.
"There's no smell left from any hallucinogenic substances. If it was a strong hallucinogenic substance that could drive them this crazy, there would be a strong scent."
"It's not drugs either."
The Proch siblings said.

While they were determining the smell, Jin was checking if there were any traces of magic on them. It could be the result of dark magic or psychic magic that Jin didn't know. There was Zipple here, after all.
However, no trace of magic was felt anywhere on the small island where the Royal Elite Army was causing chaos.
It wasn't drugs or magic. It was puzzling what kind of trick could have turned the Royal Elite Army into this state.
They turned their gaze to the other islands. They saw explosions, flames, and black smoke.

'Lata said the footprints were not from the Royal Elite Army, but the special forces. And those footprints were left with regular strides, unlike these guys. So, the special forces were on guard and realized something strange happened to the Royal Elite Army and started moving.'
A hypothesis quickly came to mind.
They couldn't tell what was driving people crazy, but it didn't affect those above a certain level.
"Let's move."
It wasn't a difficult hypothesis to verify. All they had to do was compare the other islands where battles were taking place.
On the next island they visited, they saw Zipple's wizards fighting among themselves.
"Ugh!"
"Kah!"
Like the Royal Elite Army, they were also attacking each other in a crazed state, but the situation was much worse.
"Tsk, this is quite disgusting."
Murakan frowned.
Zipple's wizards were fighting with staffs and bare hands, not with magic.

Even though the Royal Elite Army lost their minds, they still had their full strength as warriors, killing each other with a single blow. In contrast, the wizards needed a gruesome process to kill each other without magic.
"Now it's clear that Zipple is not behind this. Let's find the next island. The Kinzelro fellows should be here too."
Finding the island where Kinzelro was located was particularly easy.
From the island right in front of them, they heard a sound like a beast's howl. It was the sound made by Kinzelro's beastmen.
The ones fighting on the island were the enemy tribes.
With beastmen clawing and biting each other, it was confirmed that even the wide-eyed beastmen were affected. Kinzelro was not the culprit either.
"When was it, fifteen hundred years ago? Or even before that? It felt like this when Helluram spread a strange plague. Everyone went completely mad."
"Is there a chance that the witch is involved?"

"I don't think so. Helluram's plague started with a curse, so if that were the case, our snake-eyed friends here would be affected too. If Helluram is here, only you and I can be completely free from the curse, kid."
They visited a few more islands where signs of battle were seen. Each island had similar scenes.
The only difference was that on some islands, various factions were entangled in fighting.
There were places where the Royal Elite Army and enemy tribes were fighting together in madness, and other islands where enemy tribes, Zipple, or all three were fighting together.
The crazed ones were simply showing a tendency to attack anything they saw.
The reason why they were only fighting among allies on the first three islands was simply because they were stationed there.
The hypothesis was correct.
Jin was almost certain now.
"It seems to be related to the 7-star level. This situation is most likely caused by Amela with high probability."
As Jin spoke, the group's attention gathered.
"Kid, what are you talking about?"
"I don't know exactly what's driving people mad, but the standard is 7-star. Starting from 7-star, they are either unaffected or can resist it."
The Royal Elite Army was a group made up of the best soldiers, not knights. Therefore, excluding the commanders, they were all 6-star or below.
The same went for the wizards who were killing each other. They were 6-star or below wizards, not from the White Night or the Ghost Brigade, or from the individual magic towers' first armies.
The enemy tribes were also all 6-star or below, and no commanders were seen.

"There were no corpses of 6-star or higher commanders on all the islands where the three factions fought. After the problem occurred, the commanders took refuge. That's what it means. The special task force that Lata mentioned also moved in that way."
The reason for concluding 7-stars was not only because everyone was estimated to be 6-stars or below.
The biggest reason was this.
"And I don't see any crazed Runcandel."
Runcandel doesn't send out 6-star Guardian Knights on external missions in Huphester. This means that all the Guardian Knights here were composed of at least 7-stars.
As all three factions were stationed nearby, Runcandel must have set up a camp nearby as well. The fact that not a single person is seen means that they all safely escaped.
First, they had to find the island where Runcandel was and the commanders of the other factions.
"Murakan."
[Yes.]
"I think it's better to just fly."
The reason for using a boat, which was inconvenient to come all the way here, was none other than this.
Gaipa Island was Amela's residence, and the group came to recruit her. However, flying directly in someone else's territory was considered a huge breach of etiquette.
Since major forces would have brought their troops to show off their power, they also intended to differentiate themselves.
Whoosh...!
Murakan transformed back into his original form and flapped his wings. As they ascended into the sky, the group was able to look down at Gaipa Island.
The largest island in the center of the island group came into view. The whole island looked as if it was covered with dark mold.
At first glance, it seemed similar to aura, but it was much more murky and heavy.
Anyone could intuitively sense that the culprit causing people to go mad was that energy.
And around the huge black energy, members from each faction who 'hadn't gone mad' had taken their positions.
They were sweating to prevent the black energy from proliferating, and soon the group could see the shape of the energy changing as if molding clay.
Slime, slime, slime-!
'What's that? A human?'
What the black energy covering the island had formed was the shape of a human.
Smaller than Zephyrin, but a much larger figure than Murakan.
And that figure oddly resembled a person Jin despised quite a bit.
'Hubert... Gaston!?'
The moment Jin recalled the man's name, the newly-formed black figure opened its mouth.
[You've been bothering me too much.]
Immediately after that, the black figure seemed to inhale as if to spew breath like a dragon.
